newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan tea prices mixed at firm rates.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan tea prices mixed at firm rates.

text.p: Tea prices were mixed at Kenya's weekly export auction in Mombasa on Monday and general demand was good at firm rates, traders said.
Brighter BP1s held firm while mediums were firm to four U.S. cents dearer. Brighter PF1s tended dearer while mediums appreciated by up to seven cents with quality.
PDUSTs met an irregular market but on balance were firm while mediums advanced by up to 12 cents and lower mediums sold at last prices. Brighter DUST1s gained upto five cents.
Fannings were irregularly lower while BMFs were dearer.
Pakistan blenders and Egypt were the main buyers.
